rules.title: Minimum Rental Debt Threshold for Nonpayment Eviction
rules.requirement: Landlords may not evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent unless the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent for an equivalent unit size in the Oakland-Fremont metro area.

coverage.summary: Applies to fully or partially covered rental units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

rules.title: Elimination of Fixed-Term Lease Renewal Refusal Eviction
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from evicting a tenant solely for failing or refusing to sign a substantially similar lease upon the expiration of a fixed-term lease.

coverage.summary: Applies to fully or partially covered rental units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

rules.title: Annual General Adjustment Maximum Cap
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for fully covered rental units is capped at a maximum of 5% per year, regardless of higher Consumer Price Index calculation formulas.

coverage.summary: Applies to fully covered rental units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
